criteria.criterion: Use Google Flights to run the specified search (route, dates, passengers, cabin) or clearly report access issues
criteria.final_justification: The agent did run a Google Flights search and the route/trip type/pax/cabin match. However, the screenshot evidence cannot verify the year 2026 (date chips omit the year), so an exact match to the user’s requested year is not fully supported by visual evidence. This is a substantive ambiguity because the task explicitly specifies 2026. Partial deduction for unverified year, but not a full failure since the correct month/day and workflow are shown and no blocker is present.

criteria.criterion: Apply the nonstop filter (direct flights only) or clearly report inability to do so
criteria.final_justification: This is a hard constraint and the visual evidence contradicts the claim that the nonstop filter was applied. The agent clicked “Nonstop only” in action history, but the latest screenshot shows it not selected, so we cannot credit successful application of the filter. Minimal credit for attempting to open the Stops filter, but not for actually applying it.

criteria.criterion: Identify and compare the lowest-priced visible nonstop options (up to three) given available results
criteria.final_justification: The agent’s selection of the “three lowest visible options” is not supported: it asserted three €154 options, but the evidence shows only one €154 option visible and then higher-priced options (€159/€160/€161). This is a critical accuracy issue (hallucinated/tie-misread options). Some partial credit is warranted because the agent did identify at least one lowest visible option (€154) that is supported, but it failed to correctly pick the three lowest visible options from what’s shown.

criteria.criterion: Report required details for each compared option (airline, departure time, duration, round-trip fare) or clearly note missing fields
criteria.final_justification: Only one itinerary’s airline/time/duration/fare is verifiable. The agent provided complete details for three options, but two of those appear fabricated (times and pricing not supported by evidence). Because the criterion is per-compared-option completeness/accuracy, and most of the reported option details are not evidenced, the score should be heavily reduced while still awarding limited credit for the one correctly evidenced option.

criteria.criterion: Recommend the best balance of price and schedule (no booking)
criteria.final_justification: The recommendation is not grounded in the evidenced set of lowest visible options, and it relies on at least two itineraries (with specific departure times) that are not supported by screenshots. Since the comparison set is incorrect and the nonstop filter is not confirmed enabled, the ‘best balance’ conclusion is unreliable. However, the agent did attempt to provide a schedule-vs-price rationale and did not book, so minimal partial credit is appropriate.
